blockers.message: sans detection-delay/missed-event/false-escalation metrics are not scientifically valid for this cohort (ground-truth status counts: {'confirmed_none': 5, 'event_unknown_onset': 3}). A case with an event flagged but unknown onset day (or with no event-occurrence model at all) must never be counted as healthy, as detected, or as a valid zero. Requires registry/design_decisions.py::sans_venous_onset_day_assignment to be approved and implemented before this cohort can be scored.

venous detection-delay/missed-event/false-escalation metrics are not scientifically valid for this cohort (ground-truth status counts: {'undetermined': 8}). A case with an event flagged but unknown onset day (or with no event-occurrence model at all) must never be counted as healthy, as detected, or as a valid zero. Requires registry/design_decisions.py::sans_venous_onset_day_assignment to be approved and implemented before this cohort can be scored. Venous additionally has no approved event-occurrence model at all (unlike SANS's approved susceptibility/event-rate scheme) - every venous case reads as undetermined regardless of onset day.
